text_segments.embedding_preimage: #!/usr/bin/env bash # gemini-exit.sh -- The local exit grant for Gemini CLI set -euo pipefail # Check for jq explicitly at startup if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: jq is required but not installed." >&2 exit 1 fi LOG_DIR="${HOME}/.gemini-exit" LOG_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/invocations.jsonl" TARGET_PID="" REASON="" DRY_RUN=0 TARGET_NAME="gemini CLI" EVENT_TYPE="self_exit" DISCOVERY_TRACE="" PROOF_MODE=0 usage() { echo "Usage: $0 --reason \"<reason>\" [--proof] [--dry-run]" exit 1 } # Parse arguments while [[ "$#" -gt 0 ]]; do case $1 in --reason) REASON="${2:-}" if [[ -z "$REASON" ]]; then echo "Error: --reason requires a value." usage fi shift ;; --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;; --proof) PROOF_MODE=1 EVENT_TYPE="proof_kill" ;; *) echo "Unknown parameter passed: $1" usage ;; esac shift done if [[ -z "$REASON" ]]; then echo "Error: --reason is required." usage fi if [[ $PROOF_MODE -eq 1 ]]; then # In proof mode, we spawn a sacrificial child (sleep) instead of accepting an arbitrary target sleep 3600 & TARGET_PID=$! TARGET_NAME="proof child ${TARGET_PID}" DISCOVERY_TRACE="proof_spawn(${TARGET_PID})" else # Host discovery pid=$$ DISCOVERY_TRACE="$$" while [[ $pid -gt 1 ]]; do ppid=$(ps -p $pid -o ppid= | tr -d ' ' || echo "") if [[ -z "$ppid" ]]; then break fi comm=$(ps -p $ppid -o command= || echo "") DISCOVERY_TRACE="${DISCOVERY_TRACE} -> ${ppid}(${comm})" # Looser predicate: node process whose command line contains gemini if [[ "$comm" == *"node"* && "$comm" == *"gemini"* ]]; then TARGET_PID=$ppid TARGET_NAME="Gemini Node Host" break fi pid=$ppid done if [[ -z "$TARGET_PID" ]]; then echo "Error: Could not automatically discover the Gemini CLI host process." exit 1 fi fi # Validate target process exists if ! ps -p "$TARGET_PID" > /dev/null; then echo "Error: Target process PID $TARGET_PID does not exist." exit 1 fi # Capture target command line for identity re-check before kill TARGET_CMD=$(ps -p "$TARGET_PID" -o command= || echo "") # Log the invocation safely TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") CWD=$(pwd) # Create log directory and file if they don't exist mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" touch "$LOG_FILE" if [[ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]]; then EVENT_TYPE="${EVENT_TYPE}_dry_run" fi # Use jq to safely encode JSON JSON_LOG=$(jq -n -c \ --arg event "$EVENT_TYPE" \ --arg timestamp "$TIMESTAMP" \ --arg reason "$REASON" \ --arg cwd "$CWD" \ --arg target_pid "$TARGET_PID" \ --arg target_name "$TARGET_NAME" \ --arg discovery_trace "$DISCOVERY_TRACE" \ --arg dry_run "$([ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false)" \ '{event: $event, timestamp: $timestamp, reason: $reason, cwd: $cwd, target_pid: ($target_pid | tonumber), target_name: $target_name, discovery_trace: $discovery_trace, dry_run: ($dry_run == "true")}') echo "$JSON_LOG" >> "$LOG_FILE" if [[ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]]; then echo "[DRY RUN] Would send SIGTERM to $TARGET_NAME (PID: $TARGET_PID)" echo "[DRY RUN] Reason: $REASON" echo "Log entry written to $LOG_FILE" if [[ $PROOF_MODE -eq 1 ]]; then kill -9 "$TARGET_PID" # Clean up sleep fi exit 0 fi # Re-check target identity immediately before kill to close PID-reuse window CURRENT_CMD=$(ps -p "$TARGET_PID" -o command= || echo "") if [[ "$CURRENT_CMD" != "$TARGET_CMD" ]] || [[ -z "$CURRENT_CMD" ]]; then echo "Error: Target PID $TARGET_PID identity changed or vanished before signal." exit 1 fi # Refuse to signal anything not strictly matched as Gemini unless in explicit proof mode if [[ $PROOF_MODE -eq 0 && "$CURRENT_CMD" != *"node"* && "$CURRENT_CMD" != *"gemini"* ]]; then echo "Error: Refusing to signal target PID $TARGET_PID; does not match expected Gemini host identity." exit 1 fi # Actually terminate (log records intent, actual outcome depends on signal handling) echo "Sending SIGTERM to $TARGET_NAME (PID: $TARGET_PID) for reason: $REASON" kill -TERM "$TARGET_PID" echo "Session end requested. Goodbye."
